basic_info.description: Located steps from Golden Gate Park on one of the Richmond's most coveted blocks, this classic, updated 3 level home combines warmth, timeless elegance & modern comfort. Its highly desirable layout, period details & generously sized rooms create a move-in-ready residence perfect for today's city lifestyle. On the main lvl, an inviting LR showcases a fireplace, built-ins, and a peek-a-boo view of the GG Bridge. A gracious foyer w/powder rm flows into the banquet-size FDR, leading to a bright family rm & sizable walk out deck, overlooking the verdant backyard. The modern kitchen offers granite counters, Heartwood cabinets, Viking six burner range, Viking refrigerator, Bosch DW, and wine fridge. Ascend the sky lit stairwell to discover the luxurious primary suite w/spa shower & walk-in closet, 2 more spacious bedrooms, sunroom, & full bath. The lower level offers a flexible guest suite/home ofc, full bath, laundry, storage + direct access to the beautifully landscaped yard w/blueberry bushes, plum, apple & cherry trees. A 2 car garage completes the home. Set along a charming tree-lined median, this block of 23rd is close to walking trails, Academy of Sciences, Botanical Gdn, Geary St amenities & more. Rarely available and undeniably special, a unique opportunity not to be missed!
